headline.question: how hard is 15-451, what is the workload, and is it worth it?
headline.answer_md:
## 15-451 (Algorithm Design & Analysis): Difficulty, Workload, and Worth

---

### Overall Difficulty

The course has a reputation for being genuinely hard. One student stated bluntly:

> "15-451 is personally the most difficult class I have taken at CMU."

[bowad-15-451-15#0 · bowad — course reviews · Fall 2023 · https://bowad.net/courses/]

The same reviewer offered this measured take on the promise vs. reality of the course:

> "The idea of a course giving you an 'algorithmic toolbox' is appealing, and I did learn about interesting algorithms from this class, but the scope and exams are not to be underestimated."

[bowad-15-451-15#1 · bowad — course reviews · Fall 2023 · https://bowad.net/courses/]

---

### Professor-Specific Notes

The evidence includes ratings for two instructors who have taught 15-451 — note these differ significantly:

- **David Woodruff**: 5/5 overall, 100% would take again, difficulty rated **4.5/5** (2 ratings). [rmp-davidwoodruff-15-451#0 · RateMyProfessors — David Woodruff · 2026-08 · https://www.ratemyprofessors.com/professor/2450324]
- **Danny Sleator**: 2.3/5 overall, only **33% would take again**, difficulty rated **4/5** (6 ratings). [rmp-dannysleator-15-451#0 · RateMyProfessors — Danny Sleator · 2026-08 · https://www.ratemyprofessors.com/professor/776875]

These are starkly different experiences — **who teaches your section matters a lot**.

---

### Is It Worth It?

Despite the difficulty, student sentiment on value is generally positive. One student noted:

> "Although 15-451 is a requirement, I thought it was a well-taught requirement, and I found both the professors to be very helpful and supportive."

[abigalekim-15-451-10#0 · Abigale Kim — course reviews · Spring 2021 · https://abigalekim.github.io/courses/]

---

### Caveats & Conflicts

- The Abigale Kim review is from **Spring 2021**, so the professor lineup may have changed.
- The Woodruff RMP rating is based on only **2 ratings** — treat with caution.
- There is a **clear conflict** between the Woodruff and Sleator experiences; your section assignment could meaningfully shape your outcome.

---

### Source Mix
| Source | Type |
|--------|------|
| bowad.net | Personal blog/course reviews |
| abigalekim.github.io | Personal blog/course reviews |
| RateMyProfessors (×2) | RMP |

---

### Recommendation

Expect **high difficulty** — one student called it the hardest CMU class they took — with demanding exams and broad scope. The material is widely considered valuable (algorithms are core to CS interviews and research). **Check which professor is teaching your section carefully**: the gap between the Woodruff and Sleator ratings is significant, and if you have a choice, that decision alone could affect your experience substantially.

facets.question: is 15-451 conceptually hard or is it mostly grinding and volume of work?
facets.answer_md:
## 15-451 Difficulty: Conceptual vs. Volume?

The evidence available doesn't cleanly separate "conceptual difficulty" from "volume/grind" for 15-451, but here's what students and ratings do say:

**General Course Difficulty**

One student calls it flatly the hardest course they've taken at CMU: "15-451 is personally the most difficult class I have taken at CMU" [bowad-15-451-15#0 · bowad — course reviews · Fall 2023 · https://bowad.net/courses/]. They add a specific warning about scope and assessments: "The idea of a course giving you an 'algorithmic toolbox' is appealing, and I did learn about interesting algorithms from this class, but the scope and exams are not to be underestimated." [bowad-15-451-15#1 · bowad — course reviews · Fall 2023 · https://bowad.net/courses/] — the mention of *scope* and *exams* (rather than homework load) hints that the conceptual breadth and exam difficulty are major pain points.

**Professor-Level Difficulty Ratings (RMP)**

- **David Woodruff**: difficulty **4.5/5** (2 ratings) [rmp-davidwoodruff-15-451#0 · RateMyProfessors — David Woodruff · 2026-08 · https://www.ratemyprofessors.com/professor/2450324]
- **Danny Sleator**: difficulty **4/5** (6 ratings) [rmp-dannysleator-15-451#0 · RateMyProfessors — Danny Sleator · 2026-08 · https://www.ratemyprofessors.com/professor/776875]

Both sections are rated high-difficulty regardless of instructor.

**A Contrasting View**

One student (Spring 2021) found it manageable with support: "Although 15-451 is a requirement, I thought it was a well-taught requirement, and I found both the professors to be very helpful and supportive." [abigalekim-15-451-10#0 · Abigale Kim — course reviews · Spring 2021 · https://abigalekim.github.io/courses/]

---

**Bottom Line:** The evidence points more toward **conceptual/scope difficulty** (broad algorithmic material, hard exams) than pure grind — the word "scope" and emphasis on exams is telling. However, the evidence is thin and doesn't directly benchmark homework volume, so treat this as partial. The Spring 2021 review is also a few years old. **Recommendation:** Expect genuine conceptual challenge across a wide range of algorithms topics, and prepare especially seriously for exams.

**Source mix:** 1 personal blog (bowad), 1 personal blog (Abigale Kim), 2 RateMyProfessors entries — no Reddit in this evidence set.

## Is 15-451 Worth Taking?

The evidence on this course is limited but offers a few useful data points. Note the source mix here is: 2× RateMyProfessors aggregates, 2× personal student course-review blogs — no Reddit threads or detailed payoff breakdowns are present in the available evidence.

---

### What the course offers (the "toolbox" argument)

One student frames the appeal well but adds a caution:

> "The idea of a course giving you an 'algorithmic toolbox' is appealing, and I did learn about interesting algorithms from this class, but the scope and exams are not to be underestimated."

[bowad-15-451-15#1 · bowad — course reviews · Fall 2023 · https://bowad.net/courses/]

So the advertised payoff — a broad algorithmic foundation — does materialize, but it comes with real cost.

---

### Difficulty: be prepared

The course is described bluntly as a serious undertaking:

> "15-451 is personally the most difficult class I have taken at CMU."

[bowad-15-451-15#0 · bowad — course reviews · Fall 2023 · https://bowad.net/courses/]

Difficulty ratings from RMP back this up: David Woodruff's section is rated **4.5/5 difficulty** [rmp-davidwoodruff-15-451#0 · RateMyProfessors — David Woodruff · 2026-08 · https://www.ratemyprofessors.com/professor/2450324] and Danny Sleator's **4/5 difficulty** [rmp-dannysleator-15-451#0 · RateMyProfessors — Danny Sleator · 2026-08 · https://www.ratemyprofessors.com/professor/776875].

---

### Professor choice matters — a lot

| Professor | Overall | Would Take Again | Difficulty |
|---|---|---|---|
| David Woodruff | 5/5 | 100% | 4.5/5 |
| Danny Sleator | 2.3/5 | 33% | 4/5 |

[rmp-davidwoodruff-15-451#0 · 2026-08] [rmp-dannysleator-15-451#0 · 2026-08]

That gap in satisfaction is striking. One student (Spring 2021, so somewhat dated) had a positive experience: "Although 15-451 is a requirement, I thought it was a well-taught requirement, and I found both the professors to be very helpful and supportive." [abigalekim-15-451-10#0 · Abigale Kim — course reviews · Spring 2021 · https://abigalekim.github.io/courses/] — but this predates some of the more critical Sleator reviews.

---

### Caveats & gaps

- **What it "unlocks"** (prerequisites for other courses, job recruiting signal, grad school value) is **not directly addressed** in the available evidence — the evidence does not speak to downstream course access or career payoff.
- The Abigale Kim review is from **Spring 2021** and may not reflect current course structure.
- RMP ratings for Woodruff are based on only **2 ratings** — too small to generalize confidently.

---

### Direct Recommendation

If 15-451 is a requirement for your program, the evidence suggests it is **genuinely educational** but **genuinely hard** — plan accordingly. If you have a choice of instructor, the RMP data strongly favors Woodruff over Sleator, though sample sizes are small. The evidence here **cannot** tell you what specific courses or opportunities it unlocks — you'd want to check CMU's prerequisite chains separately.
